equity.equity_measurement: Referent is the white female incidence rate; only black and white women are compared, and other racial/ethnic groups are omitted.

notes: Incidence estimates are taken from a CDC surveillance report; the PAP, excess infections and the test are the report's own computations from them. The PAP and the excess infections are arithmetic, not procedures.
view_issues: The 7% PAP decrease (p = 0.15) is described as a decrease despite nonsignificance. The 93% (excess among black women only) and the PAP of 0.70 (excess over black plus white infections) use different denominators.
